title: HTTP caching: ETag, conditional requests, static asset policy
objective: Correct Cache-Control/ETag/304 for static assets and a handler helper for API responses; private data is never cacheable by shared caches.
acceptance_criteria: First request returns 200 with an ETag; the conditional request returns 304 with no body
Hashed assets are immutable; index.html is revalidated
Authenticated responses stay private with Vary set correctly
